story: After a fierce battle to form the breakaway, a group of eight riders finally got clear. Then, when no one expected it, Healy launched a solo attack and rode alone for over 40 kilometers to claim victory. Behind him, fellow escapee Van der Poel just managed to hold on to enough of a gap to reclaim the yellow jersey from Pogacar, by a single second.
